# Ed448 interoperability fixtures

Generated by other implementations, so the tests check this package
against them rather than against itself. Test-only keys; never use them
for anything else.

- `bind/`: `dnssec-keygen -a ED448` and `dnssec-signzone -z -P
  -s 20260101000000 -e 20360101000000` from BIND 9 (OpenSSL 3 backend).
  `Private-key-format: v1.3`.
- `domain/`: `Ktest.+016+07379`, copied from NLnet Labs' domain crate
  (`test-data/dnssec-keys/`, BSD-3-Clause). `Private-key-format: v1.2`,
  the format Cascade and dnst write.
- `openssl/`: `openssl genpkey -algorithm ED448` (OpenSSL 3.6), the raw
  public key from `openssl pkey -pubout -outform DER`, and a signature of
  `msg.txt` from `openssl pkeyutl -sign -rawin`.
